messages.content:
You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (43.0 s) ===
[0.0-3.0] JULIANA (Determined, Defiant): "At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me."
[2.9-3.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her march ahead, his expression solemn and deeply reflective.
[3.5-6.5] ACTION: The heavy wooden cottage door creaks open. Juliana steps across the threshold into the dark, barren room.
[3.6-6.3] SOUND_FX: Door hinges groaning open followed by the hollow thump of footsteps on wet wood floorboards.
[6.5-7.5] SCREEN: Close-up overhead shot of a wooden bucket catching raindrops dripping steadily from a leak in the ceiling.
[6.5-9.8] SOUND_FX: Rhythmic water drips plinking into the metal-rimmed wooden bucket.
[7.5-9.8] SCREEN: Medium wide shot past the drip bucket as the Mysterious Bearded Man closes the door behind them.
[9.8-11.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing in the dim light by the door.
[10.6-11.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Humble, Apologetic): "I am sorry."
[11.8-13.2] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana gazing around the rustic interior, taking in the sparse surroundings.
[13.2-16.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking at her with somber honesty.
[13.4-14.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere): "You came from comfort."
[14.9-17.1] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Sincere): "This is all I can give you now."
[16.2-18.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana undoing the ribbon tie of her black cloak and letting it slide off her shoulders.
[16.4-18.9] ACTION: Juliana removes her dark cloak, revealing her damp white bridal dress underneath.
[18.6-20.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's hand pressing against the cold, condensation-fogged windowpane.
[20.9-24.6] SCREEN: Side profile shot of Juliana looking out the rain-streaked window into the quiet forest.
[21.1-22.6] JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful): "It is quiet."
[23.1-24.4] JULIANA (Gentle, Peaceful): "Very quiet."
[24.6-26.1] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Juliana looking at the Mysterious Bearded Man watching her attentively.
[26.1-28.1] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana turning back toward him, a soft, genuine smile illuminating her face.
[26.2-27.9] JULIANA (Earnest, Content): "I think I like that."
[28.1-29.6] SCREEN: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, slightly surprised by her reaction.
[28.2-29.9] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Incredulous): "You are not disappointed?"
[29.6-31.1] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana meeting his gaze honestly.
[30.1-31.1] JULIANA (Direct, Soft): "I am."
[31.1-34.0] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Juliana as the Mysterious Bearded Man listens intently.
[31.8-34.0] JULIANA (Warm, Reassuring): "But not because of you."
[34.0-36.5] SCREEN: Medium shot as Juliana grabs a rag from the rustic wooden table and begins briskly scrubbing the damp surface.
[34.1-36.6] JULIANA (Determined, Practical): "If this is our home, I want it clean."
[36.5-37.6] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man stepping forward to intervene gently.
[36.5-38.5] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Caring, Tender): "You don't have to do that tonight."
[37.6-39.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's hands vigorously scrubbing grime from the wooden tabletop.
[39.4-42.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's face, her voice catching with raw, suppressed emotion as she scrubs.
[40.0-43.0] JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling): "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."

=== CLIP B (35.9 s) ===
[0.0-3.1] JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling): "If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost."
[2.0-4.2] SCREEN: Full shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man standing motionless, his gaze filled with empathy and understanding.
[4.2-6.7] ACTION: Instead of stopping her, the Mysterious Bearded Man kneels beside the table and begins inspecting and adjusting the wobbly table leg to help.
[4.2-6.7] SCREEN: Medium low shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man kneeling beside Juliana as she wipes the table.
[6.7-7.7] ACTION: Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.
[6.7-7.7] SCREEN: Wide shot of Juliana sweeping dust toward the large stone fireplace.
[7.7-10.9] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.
[7.7-10.9] SCREEN: Tracking shot following the Mysterious Bearded Man as he sets the firewood into the stone fireplace.
[10.9-13.7] ACTION: He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.
[10.9-13.7] SCREEN: Extreme close-up on hands striking flint, sparks showering onto the twigs and catching fire.
[13.7-14.9] SCREEN: Medium close-up of vibrant orange flames rapidly spreading across the dry logs, crackling warmly.
[13.7-19.9] SOUND_FX: Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.
[14.9-17.4] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana standing by the table, broom resting against her hip, bathed in the amber firelight.
[17.4-19.7] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.
[17.4-19.7] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising before the blazing fireplace.
[18.9-19.7] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Relieved): "There."
[19.7-21.6] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking at him with radiant gratitude and a gentle smile.
[21.6-23.7] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gesturing faintly to the modest room.
[22.0-23.5] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Quiet, Modest): "It is not much."
[23.7-25.7] SCREEN: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.
[24.1-26.1] JULIANA (Soft, Comforted): "It is enough for tonight."
[25.7-28.1] SCREEN: Wide shot framing the roaring hearth fire between them as the Mysterious Bearded Man crouches down beside her on the stone floor.
[28.1-30.9] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana pulling her cloak tighter, her face glowing warmly in the firelight.
[28.3-30.3] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "I lost my home today."
[30.5-31.7] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "My family."
[30.9-32.9] SCREEN: Close-up of the glowing embers and dancing flames inside the fireplace.
[31.9-34.7] JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable): "Everything I thought my life would be."
[32.9-34.2] SCREEN: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred, work-worn hands resting quietly on his knees.
[34.2-35.9] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Juliana looking down into the flames, a peaceful serenity washing over her features.
[34.9-35.9] JULIANA (Gentle, Surprised): "And yet..."
